notes: Lines confirmed from official OrangePi Zero 2W wiki (orangepi.org). gpiochip1=300b000.pinctrl (288 lines, main GPIO). H618 bank offsets: PC=64, PH=224, PI=256. WARNING: All four pins are on bank PI — H618 initializes banks simultaneously, so all pins may briefly go LOW at boot (false bump triggers). Pin31/PI15/line271 and Pin35/PI2/line258 have board-level pull-downs and may malfunction. Mapping: front_right=PI0/pin29, front_left=PI15/pin31, side_left=PI2/pin35, side_right=PI12/pin33 (user request 2026-05-08 — left/right swapped from physical RPi pinout to match actual wiring). Previous mapping had PI16/pin37 for side_right (EMAC0, broken).
